target.body:
Bumps [trufflesecurity/trufflehog](https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog) from 3.95.7 to 3.95.9.
Release notes

Sourced from trufflesecurity/trufflehog's releases.

v3.95.9

What's Changed

  • feat: add OpenRouter detector by @​McPatate in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4500
  • Integrations fully codeowns detectors by @​trufflesteeeve in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#5104
  • [INS-332] Add New Relic Insights Insert key detector by @​mustansir14 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4778
  • [INS-351] Added Duffel Token Detector by @​MuneebUllahKhan222 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4795
  • [INS-341] Added Shippo detector by @​MuneebUllahKhan222 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4820
  • [INS-467] Add IPinfo detector to default detectors list by @​mustansir14 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4970
  • fix: reject --include-repos/--exclude-repos with --repo in github scan by @​kashifkhan0771 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#5112
  • [INS-468] Add improved lob detector to defaults.go by @​mustansir14 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4971
  • feat(action): add image input to allow registry mirror overrides by @​eightseventhreethree in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4965
  • feat: Support archived repo exclusion from GH org scans by @​hibare in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4875
  • [INT-715] Retry transient failures when verifying OpenAI keys by @​bill-rich in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#5117
  • [INS-410] Added batch token detector by @​MuneebUllahKhan222 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4824
  • [INT-650] Don't log as error when git diff is too long by @​bill-rich in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#5113

New Contributors

  • @​McPatate made their first contribution in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4500
  • @​eightseventhreethree made their first contribution in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4965

Full Changelog: https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/compare/v3.95.8...v3.95.9

v3.95.8

What's Changed

  • removed "unauthorized" as exception for rotated graphana secrets by @​jordanTunstill in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#5068
  • fix(azuresastoken): match SAS tokens regardless of parameter order by @​genisis0x in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#5043
  • Add prometheus metrics for engine channels and workers by @​mcastorina in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#5095
  • [INS-465] Skip unverified JWT Detector results when feature flag is enabled by @​MuneebUllahKhan222 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#5072
  • [INS-334] Octopus Deploy detector by @​MuneebUllahKhan222 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#4787
  • Fix Syntax error in feature.go by @​MuneebUllahKhan222 in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#5109
  • Include encoded resume info instead of clobbering it by @​bill-rich in trufflesecurity/trufflehog#5110

Full Changelog: https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/compare/v3.95.7...v3.95.8

Commits
  • 27b0417 Don't log as error when git diff is too long (#5113)
  • d328285 [INS-410] Added batch token detector (#4824)
  • 33d9dad [INT-715] Retry transient failures when verifying OpenAI keys (#5117)
  • d7dcc6d feat: Support archived repo exclusion from GH org scans (#4875)
  • f845f18 feat(action): add image input to allow registry mirror overrides (#4965)
  • 6c97970 [INS-468] Add improved lob detector to defaults.go (#4971)
  • 1675e17 fix: reject --include-repos/--exclude-repos with --repo in github scan (#5112)

  • d3b5487 [INS-351] Added Duffel Token Detector (#4795)
